spec.description: Rerun of job 20261114-162937-example-targets-runtime-r3-run-verifier, which failed (VF-024) for three reasons. (1) Phase 0's fixture recipe (build_fixtures.py) compiles without -parameters or -g, so jvmcontract calls Gate.allowed's parameter arg0 while the fixture's sidecar and workflow's claim files say 'code': the three security tasks were not well-formed. build_fixtures.py is the coordinator's, so runtime now takes an optional JAVAC_FLAGS from it, and asks under Progress for JAVAC_FLAGS = ('-parameters',); this job's step 1 runs runtime_calibrate.py with --fixture-javac-flag -parameters, the calibration of that recipe (recorded as a variant in calibration.json and in every preparation's recipe), not of Phase 0's bytes. The verifier's scope now records the parameter names the loaded class has, and where from. (2) jvmcontract equivalence takes directories of classes, and was given JARs ('Not a directory'): run_verifier now extracts each side's original JAR into verifier/classes/<revision> and records it. (3) regex-probe's strict proof stops at its String parameter before reaching java.util.regex; the capability probe (jvmcontract gaps) names Pattern.compile, Pattern.matcher and Matcher.matches. The calibration now reports the refusal's and the probe's naming apart and needs one of them. Step 2 runs the integration contract with JVMCONTRACT set (Phase 0's bytes, no flag): A5 stops at workflow's task-plan stub on this branch.
